At least 20% of 741 R_A+R_B answers are broken at 0.8 + 0.8.
At least 30% of 39 neuron single answers are broken at alpha 1.13.
Median row interaction share over real ordered pairs at 0.4 is at most 0.25.
Median real row share at 0.2 is at most half the median at 0.4.
At 0.4, median row b_A and b_2 over 1,482 real ordered pairs are each 0.75–1.25.
Additive pair-top agreement rises at least 20 points from 0.8 to 0.4, 95% unit-bootstrap CI > 0; 0.4 is at least 10 points above plain.
At 0.4, additive agreement exceeds winner-take-all by at least 5 points, 95% unit-bootstrap CI > 0.
Effect-matched mean real residual 95% unit-bootstrap interval is inside +/- log(1.25), with at least 70% real-position coverage.
Positive kind gap in at least 60% of 168 agreed slot×concept pairs at 0.8; median absolute gap at 0.4 is at most half the 0.8 value.
Spearman correlation between Path 2 E and Part 119 dominance is at least 0.5 across 39 units.

additional_readings: Breaking tracks how much is pushed more than which neurons are pushed. The 0.8 random-single broken share is 0.026, the 0.8 neuron-single broken share is 0.103; the measured median combined norm of same-layer 0.8 pairs is 10.050 over 102 pairs, and broken shares are 0.490 same-layer vs 0.480 different-layer.

reader_coherence.rule: The reader's coherent count is withheld if a reader scores below 10 of 12 on the known examples, or if the DeepSeek and Luna kappa on coherent is defined and below 0.6. If kappa is undefined because a reader gave one value throughout, raw agreement is reported and the count is read.
